title: Make circumstances a reason or a setting

variants.label: とあって · reason

segments.role: とあって treats the noteworthy circumstances as the reason for what followed. It is common in explanatory reports.

example.translation: Because the situation was difficult, a careful response was required.

variants.change: とあって treats the noteworthy circumstances as the reason for what followed. It is common in explanatory reports.

variants.label: にあって · setting

segments.role: にあって locates the event within the circumstances. It need not itself assert the causal link expressed by とあって.

example.translation: In the difficult circumstances, a careful response was required.

variants.change: にあって locates the event within the circumstances. It need not itself assert the causal link expressed by とあって.

question: Which construction explicitly treats the circumstance as the reason for the result?
feedback: とあって presents a noteworthy circumstance as a cause. にあって sets the situation or environment in which something occurs.
